name: Wood joinery
description: Mortise and tenon joints between two boards: adds the tenon to the rail and cuts the mortise in the stile.

rail.description: The body that gets the tenon. Its end touches the stile.

stile.description: The body that gets the mortise.

thickness.description: Tenon thickness in mm. Default: a third of the rail thickness.

length.description: Tenon length in mm. Default: two thirds of the stile, to the nearest 5 mm; the whole stile for through and bridle.

shoulder.description: Shoulder on each edge of the rail width, in mm.

haunch_width.description: Haunched only: width of the haunch in mm.

haunch_depth.description: Haunched only: depth of the haunch in mm.

glue_relief.description: Extra depth under a blind tenon, in mm. Default: 2.

clearance.description: Gap around the tenon in the mortise, in mm. Default: 0.

offset.description: Shift of the tenon across the rail thickness, in mm. Default: 0, centred.
